title: rosa rubrifolia subsp. montana
intro: Rosa rubrifolia subsp. montana, commonly known as Himalayan rose, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. It is used in traditional medicine, valued for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and alleviate skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of Rosa rubrifolia subsp. montana include its ability to calm the mind and body, as well as its analgesic and antiseptic properties, making it a popular remedy for wounds and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its potential health benefits.
